SELECT s.format, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) receipts, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonposq
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT sale_date, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dl, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) r, min(etl_loaded_at) mn, max(etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-30' AND DATE '2026-09-03' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30')
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' chk, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM p GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_multi_store', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM p GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_id)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_mixed_staff', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM p GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_multi_date', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM p GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'receipts_multi_member', count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM p GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT member_key)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_store_key', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key IS NULL AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_version_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND (f.sale_date<s.valid_from OR f.sale_date>s.valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_in_closed_store', count(*) FROM p WHERE store_id=129
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_lines_in_stg_overlap', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL SELECT 'channel_id_dist_'||coalesce(cast(channel_id as varchar),'null'), count(*) FROM p GROUP BY channel_id
UNION ALL SELECT 'netgross_mismatch', count(*) FROM p WHERE abs(net_amount*(1+vat_rate)-gross_amount)>0.02

WITH r AS (SELECT s.format, sum(receipts) receipts, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales d JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, format FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) s ON s.store_id=d.store_id WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' GROUP BY 1),
f AS (SELECT s.format, count(DISTINCT receipt_id) all_receipts, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN receipt_id END) cust_receipts, sum(net_amount) all_net, sum(CASE WHEN NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) cust_net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND f.channel_id=1 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT * FROM r JOIN f USING(format) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, s.format AS store_format,
       round(sum(f.net_amount) / count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 2) AS average_basket_value_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
  AND f.channel_id = 1
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
GROUP BY s.format
ORDER BY CASE s.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
